mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS upCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS downCount FROM stock_vote WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
SELECT vote_type FROM stock_vote WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_vote (stock_code, member_id, vote_type) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{memberId}, #{voteType}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vote_type = VALUES(vote_type), voted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
